entries.text: If at the time of birth of a person, the Sun occupy the ascendant, the person will be fond of fight, slow at work, without sight and without mercy; but if Aries be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it the person will be rich and afflicted with diseases of the eye; if Leo be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it, he will be blind at night; if Libra be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it, the person will be blind and poor; if Cancer be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it, he will have a mote in his eye.
entries.plain: Quick to fight, slow at work, with weak eyesight and little mercy. With Aries rising: wealthy but with eye trouble; Leo rising: poor night vision; Libra rising: poor eyesight and little money; Cancer rising: a spot in the eye.

entries.text: If the Sun occupy the 2nd house from the ascendant, the person will be greatly rich, will have his wealth carried away by the king and will suffer from diseases in the face.
entries.plain: Very wealthy, but loses money to those in power (today: taxes or the state), with trouble in the face or mouth.

entries.text: If at the time of birth, the Sun occupy the 3rd house from the ascendant, the person will be intelligent and powerful
entries.plain: Intelligent and strong.

entries.text: if he occupy the 4th house, the person will be afflicted with grief and mental sufferings
entries.plain: Prone to sorrow and mental strain.

entries.text: if he occupy the 5th house, he will have no sons and will be poor
entries.plain: Few or no sons, and little money.

entries.text: if he occupy the 6th house, the person will be powerful and be subjugated by his enemy
entries.plain: Strong, yet can be overpowered by opponents. (Other authors quoted in the notes say the opposite: free of enemies.)

entries.text: If at the time of birth of a person the Sun occupy the 7th house from the ascendant, the person will suffer disgrace at the hands of women
entries.plain: Faces humiliation through relationships with women.

entries.text: if he occupy the 8th house, the person will have very few sons and will become blind
entries.plain: Very few sons and trouble with eyesight.

entries.text: if he occupy the 9th house, the person will have sons wealth and comfort
entries.plain: Children, wealth and comfort.

entries.text: if he occupy the 10th house, the person will live in comfort and will be powerful
entries.plain: A comfortable life and real power or authority.

entries.text: if he occupy the 11th house the person will be very rich
entries.plain: Very wealthy.

entries.text: if he occupy the 12th house he will become an apostate
entries.plain: Turns away from the religion he was born into.

entries.text: If at the time of birth of a person the Moon occupy the ascendant such person will become dumb or mad or an idiot or blind or deaf; he will do mean deeds or will become a slave; if the rising sign occupied by the Moon be Cancer, Aries or Taurus the person will be rich, will have many sons and will be wealthy respectively.
entries.plain: A very harsh old verdict (disability, low work or servitude), except that with Cancer rising the person is rich, with Aries rising has many sons, and with Taurus rising is wealthy.

entries.text: If the Moon occupy the 2nd house from the ascendant the person will be a man of a large family.
entries.plain: A large family.

entries.text: If she occupy the third house, he will delight in torturing animals
entries.plain: A cruel streak (the text says: enjoys hurting animals).

entries.text: If she occupy the 4th or the 5th house, he will be in the full enjoyment of what the houses signify … if the Moon occupy the 4th house from the ascendant the person will be happy, will have kinsmen and houses and will be learned
entries.plain: Happy, with relatives, a home of his own and learning.

entries.text: If she occupy the 4th or the 5th house, he will be in the full enjoyment of what the houses signify … if she occupy the 5th house the person will possess intelligence, sons and the like
entries.plain: Intelligent, with children.

entries.text: If she occupy the 6th house the person will be of soft body, will have a dull appetite, will be sparing in sexual union, will be cruel and will be slow at work.
entries.plain: A delicate body, low appetite and desire, a harsh manner and slow at work.

entries.text: If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the 7th house from the ascendant the person will be jealous of the prosperity of other men and will be lustful.
entries.plain: Envious of others' success, and strongly passionate.

entries.text: If she occupy the 8th house, the person will be fickle-minded and will be afflicted with diseases.
entries.plain: A changeable mind and prone to illness.

entries.text: If she occupy the 9th house the person will be liked by all and will have sons, kinsmen and wealth.
entries.plain: Liked by everyone, with children, relatives and wealth.

entries.text: If she occupy the 10th house, he will be successful in all places, will be virtuous, wealthy, intelligent and valorous.
entries.plain: Successful everywhere: good, wealthy, clever and brave.

entries.text: If she occupy the 11th house, the person will be famous and will gain wealth
entries.plain: Famous, and gains wealth.

entries.text: if she occupy the 12th house from the ascendant, the person will be wicked and of defective limbs.
entries.plain: Bad conduct and a physical defect (a harsh old verdict).

entries.text: If at the time of birth of a person Mars occupy the ascendant, such person will possess a wounded body
entries.plain: Prone to injuries and scars.

entries.plain: Same as the Sun in the 3rd house: Intelligent and strong.

entries.text: If at the time of birth of a person Saturn occupy the ascendant, such person will be poor, will be afflicted with diseases and sexual passion, will be dirty, will suffer much from diseases while young and will be of indistinct speech. entries.plain: Poor, sickly when young, untidy and unclear in speech; but with Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces rising, happy like a king, a local leader, learned and good-looking.

entries.text: But if Saturn occupy any of the other houses (from the 2nd to the 12th) the effects will be the same as those of the Sun in the same places.

entries.text: If the benefic planets occupy the 6th, 7th and 8th houses from the Moon, the yoga is known as Adhiyoga. A person born in the yoga will become a general, a minister or a king and will be in the enjoyment of great pleasures and wealth with subdued enemies and long life and free from diseases and fear.
entries.plain: Benefic planets in the 6th, 7th and 8th from the Moon: a leader or high official, comfortable and wealthy, with enemies kept down, long life and good health.

entries.text: Excepting the Sun if the other planets occupy the 2nd, the 12th, or both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Moon, the yoga is respectively known as Sunapha, Anapha or Durudhura; otherwise, the yoga is known as Kemadruma by numerous writers.
entries.plain: Planets (other than the Sun) in the 2nd house from the Moon form Sunapha.

entries.text: Excepting the Sun if the other planets occupy the 2nd, the 12th, or both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Moon, the yoga is respectively known as Sunapha, Anapha or Durudhura; otherwise, the yoga is known as Kemadruma by numerous writers.
entries.plain: Planets (other than the Sun) in the 12th house from the Moon form Anapha.

entries.text: Excepting the Sun if the other planets occupy the 2nd, the 12th, or both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Moon, the yoga is respectively known as Sunapha, Anapha or Durudhura; otherwise, the yoga is known as Kemadruma by numerous writers.
entries.plain: Planets (other than the Sun) on both sides of the Moon (2nd and 12th) form Durudhura.

entries.text: otherwise, the yoga is known as Kemadruma by numerous writers. According to some, if the Moon occupy the Kendra house from the ascendant or if the Moon be accompanied by a planet, the yoga ceases to be a Kemadruma yoga.
entries.plain: No planet (other than the Sun) on either side of the Moon forms Kemadruma.

entries.text: A person born in a Sunapha yoga will be possessed of self-acquired property, will be a king or will resemble a king, and will be a man of intelligence, wealth and renown.
entries.plain: Builds wealth by his own effort; respected like a ruler; intelligent, rich and well known.

entries.text: A person born in an Anapha yoga will be a man of influence and authority, will be free from diseases, will have a control over his passions, will be of great renown, will be in the enjoyment of all manner of pleasures, will wear neat dress and will be free from grief.
entries.plain: Influential, healthy, self-controlled, well known, enjoys life, dresses well and is free of grief.

entries.text: A person born in a Durudhura yoga will be in the enjoyment of all manner of pleasures, will be possessed of wealth and chariot, will be liberal in his gifts and will have good servants.
entries.plain: Enjoys many pleasures, has wealth and vehicles, is generous and has good helpers.

entries.text: A person born in a Kemadruma yoga, though he may belong to a king's family, will be dirty, afflicted with grief, will do deeds not suited to his rank in life, will be poor, will serve under others and will be wicked.
entries.plain: A harsh old verdict: even from a good family, faces hardship, grief, poverty and work under others.

entries.text: Even if the person be born in other malefic Yogas the present yoga will take effect to their exclusion … Such as Kemadruma yoga. That is, suppose a person to be born in a Kemadruma yoga and suppose the benefic planets to occupy the Upachaya places from the ascendant or the Moon or both, the person will become rich and not poor.
entries.plain: Cancelled when benefic planets sit in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th from the ascendant or the Moon: then the person becomes rich, not poor.

entries.text: if the Sun and Mercury occupy a sign together, the person will be skilled in work, will be intelligent and famous, and will live in comfort
entries.plain: Sun and Mercury together: skilled at work, intelligent, well known and comfortable.

entries.text: If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be the Moon and Mars the person will earn money by the sale of works of art, of women, of liquor, and of pots and will give trouble to his mother
entries.plain: Moon and Mars together: earns from trade (the old text lists art, liquor and pots) and causes worry to his mother.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Aswini will be fond of ornaments, will be of fine appearance, will be popular, skilled in work and intelligent.
entries.plain: Likes jewellery, good-looking, popular, skilled and intelligent.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Bharani will be successful at work, truthful, free from diseases, able and free from grief.
entries.plain: Successful at work, truthful, healthy, capable and free of grief.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Krittika will be a glutton, fond of the wives of other men, of bright appearance and of wide-spread fame.
entries.plain: Big appetite, drawn to other men's wives, bright-looking and widely known.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Rohini will be truthful, will not covet the property of other men, will be of cleanly habits, of sweet speech, of firm views, and of fine appearance.
entries.plain: Truthful, not greedy, clean in habits, sweet-spoken, firm in views and good-looking.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Mrigasirsha will be of no firm principles, will be able, timid, of good speech, of active habits, rich and will indulge in sexual pleasures.
entries.plain: Changeable in principles, capable, timid, well-spoken, active, rich and pleasure-loving.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Ardra will be insincere, of irascible temper, ungrateful, troublesome and addicted to wicked deeds.
entries.plain: Insincere, quick-tempered, ungrateful, troublesome; a harsh old verdict.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Punarvasu will be devout and of patient habits, will live in comfort, will be good-natured, quiet, of wrong views, sickly, thirsty and pleased with trifles.
entries.plain: Devout, patient, comfortable, good-natured and quiet, but with mistaken views, poor health and easily pleased.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Pushya will have a control over his desires, will be generally liked, learned in the Sastras, rich and will be fond of acts of charity.
entries.plain: Self-controlled, well liked, learned, rich and charitable.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Aslesha will not be attentive to the work of other men, will be a promiscuous eater, will be sinful, ungrateful and skilled in cheating other men.
entries.plain: Careless of others' work, eats anything, ungrateful and deceptive; a harsh old verdict.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Magha will have numerous servants, will worship the Devas and Pitris and will be engaged in important works.
entries.plain: Many helpers, devoted to gods and ancestors, and does important work.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of P. Phalguni will be of sweet speech, will be liberal in his gifts, of wandering habits and will serve under kings.
entries.plain: Sweet-spoken, generous, fond of travel, and works for those in power.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of U. Phalguni will be generally liked, will earn money by his learning and will live in comfort.
entries.plain: Well liked, earns through learning and lives comfortably.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Hasta will be of active habits, full of resources, shameless, merciless and a thief and a drunkard.
entries.plain: Active and resourceful, but shameless and hard; a harsh old verdict (thief and drunkard).

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Chittra will wear cloths and flowers of various colors and will have beautiful eyes and limbs.
entries.plain: Dresses colourfully and has beautiful eyes and body.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Swati will be of a mild and quiet nature, will control his passion, will be skilled in trade, will be merciful, unable to bear thirst, of sweet speech and disposed to do acts of charity.
entries.plain: Mild and calm, self-controlled, good at trade, kind, sweet-spoken and charitable.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Visakha will be jealous of another's prosperity, will be a niggard, of bright appearance, of distinct speech, skilled in earning money and disposed to bring about quarrels among men.
entries.plain: Envious and stingy, but bright, clear-spoken and good at earning; can stir quarrels.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Anuradha will be rich, will live in foreign lands, will be unable to bear hunger and disposed to wander from place to place.
entries.plain: Rich, lives abroad, cannot bear hunger and likes to travel.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Jyeshta will have few friends, will be very cheerful, virtuous, and of irascible temper.
entries.plain: Few friends, very cheerful and good, but quick-tempered.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Moola will be haughty, rich, happy, not disposed to injure other men, of firm views and will live in luxury.
entries.plain: Proud, rich and happy, harms no one, firm in views and lives well.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of P. Ashadha will have an agreeable wife, will be proud and attached to friends.
entries.plain: A pleasant spouse, proud and loyal to friends.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of U. Ashadha will be obedient, will be learned in the rules of virtue, will possess many friends, will be grateful and return favors received and will be generally liked.
entries.plain: Courteous, knows right conduct, many friends, grateful and well liked.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Sravana will be prosperous and learned, will have a liberal-minded wife, will be rich and of wide-spread fame.
entries.plain: Prosperous and learned, with a generous spouse, rich and widely known.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Dhanishta will be liberal in gifts, rich, valiant, fond of music and will be a niggard.
entries.plain: Generous yet careful with money, rich, brave and fond of music.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Satabhishak will be harsh in his speech, will be truthful, will suffer grief, will conquer his enemies, will thoughtlessly engage in work and will be of independent ways.
entries.plain: Blunt in speech but truthful, has sorrows, defeats rivals, acts on impulse and is independent.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of P. Bhadrapada will suffer from grief, will place his wealth at the disposal of his wife, will be of distinct speech, will be skilled in earning money and will be a niggard.
entries.plain: Has sorrows, lets the spouse manage money, speaks clearly, good at earning but stingy.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of U. Bhadrapada will be an able speaker, will be happy, will possess children and grand-children, will conquer his enemies and will be virtuous.
entries.plain: A good speaker, happy, with children and grandchildren, defeats rivals and is virtuous.

entries.text: A person born when the Moon passes through the asterism of Revati will possess perfect limbs, will be liked by all the people, will be deeply learned, will never covet the property of other men and will be rich.
entries.plain: Well-formed body, liked by all, deeply learned, not greedy and rich.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Aries will have round red eyes, will be fond of vegetable food and will eat hot meals but in a moderate degree; will be of a quickly relenting nature, will be fond of travels and of sexual union; will be of strong knees; will possess no permanent wealth; will be fond of fight and of women; will be skilled in befriending other men
entries.plain: Restless and quick to forgive, fond of travel and pleasure, energetic, but money does not stay.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus will be of fine appearance and of beautiful gait; will possess large thighs and face; will possess marks on his back, face and sides, will be liberal in his gifts; will bear misfortunes; will possess great influence and authority … will be of agreeable manners and of patient nature; will be a great eater; will be fond of women; will be attached to his friends and will be happy both when young and old.
entries.plain: Good-looking and generous, patient in hardship, influential and pleasant.

entries.text: person born with the Moon in sign Gemini will be fond of women, will be skilled in sexual union; will possess red eyes; will be learned in the Sastras; will carry messages; will possess curling hairs and a sharp intellect … will possess beautiful features; will be of sweet speech; will be a great eater; will be fond of music, and skilled in the rules of dance
entries.plain: Sharp-minded and learned, charming and sweet-spoken, a good messenger, fond of music and pleasure.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer will possess a bent body; will walk fast; will have a high hip; will be subject to the influence of women; will have an excellent friend; will be learned in Astrology; will have numerous houses; will have a wealth which will increase and decrease as the Moon
entries.plain: Moves fast, influenced by women, a loyal friend, interested in astrology, owns houses; wealth rises and falls like the Moon.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Leo will be of irascible temper, of large cheeks, broad face and brown eyes … will be liberal in his gifts; will be bold in fight; will be of fixed principles; will be haughty and attached to his mother.
entries.plain: Quick-tempered but generous, brave, firm in principles, proud and close to his mother.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo will, out of modesty, be of mild and beautiful eyes and gait; will have his shoulders and arms sunk or depressed; will live in comfort, will be of soft body; will be truthful, will be skilled in dance, music and painting; will be learned in the Sastras; will be virtuous and intelligent
entries.plain: Modest, gentle, comfortable, truthful, artistic (dance, music, painting), learned and intelligent.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Libra will respect the Devas, Brahmins, and holy men; will be intelligent, will never covet the property of other men; will lead a religious life; will be subject to the influence of women; will be tall; will have a raised nose; will be of thin and defective limbs and fond of travels; will be rich; will be a trader
entries.plain: Respects holy people, intelligent, not greedy, religious, influenced by women, tall, fond of travel.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Scorpio will have broad eyes, a broad breast and round shanks, thighs and knees; will be separated from his parents and preceptors; will be afflicted with diseases when young; will be respected by kings
entries.plain: Broad-chested, separated from parents and teachers, sickly when young, respected by those in power.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittari will have a long face and neck; will inherit his father's property; will be liberal in his gift; will be a literary author; will be powerful and skilled in speech … will be of a deep and inventive intellect, will be a man of right understanding
entries.plain: Inherits from his father, generous, a writer, strong and well-spoken, with a deep, inventive mind.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn will be ever attached to his wife and children; will do deeds of virtue; will have thin lower limbs, good eyes and a thin waist; will be open to advice; will be of amiable manners and slow at work; will not bear cold
entries.plain: Devoted to spouse and children, virtuous, takes advice, pleasant, slow at work and dislikes cold.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius will have a neck like that of the Camel … will rise and fall by turns; will be fond of flowers and perfumes; and will be attached to friends and will walk without feeling tired.
entries.plain: Fortunes rise and fall, loves flowers and scents, loyal to friends, and has great stamina.

entries.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Pisces will be a dealer in the produce of the sea and a trader in general; will be fond of his wife and clothes; will have perfect limbs, a bright body, long nose and large head, will put his enemies into disgrace, will be subject to the influence of women, will have beautiful eyes, and will be fair, rich, happy and learned.
entries.plain: A trader (traditionally in sea produce), fond of spouse and clothes, good-looking, beats rivals.

entries.text: If the planets to which good effects have been assigned occupy their exaltation signs such effects will fully come to pass. … But if they occupy their exaltation signs, the evil effects will fail
entries.plain: In its exaltation sign, a planet's good effects come fully true and its bad effects fail.

entries.text: if they occupy their own houses one-half of such effects will come to pass … if they occupy their own signs then one-quarter
entries.plain: In its own sign, a planet gives about half of its good effects (and a quarter of its bad ones).

entries.text: if they occupy their friendly signs one-quarter of such effects will come to pass … if they occupy their friendly signs, then one-half
entries.plain: In a friendly sign, a planet gives about a quarter of its good effects (and half of its bad ones).

entries.text: if they occupy their inimical signs less than one-quarter of such effects will come to pass … If they occupy their inimical signs, then three-fourths
entries.plain: In an enemy sign, less than a quarter of the good effects come true (and three-quarters of the bad).

entries.text: if the planets occupy their depression signs or if they happen to be Astangata planets the good effects described will wholly fail. … If the effects be bad, then if the planets occupy their depression signs or if they be Astangata planets, the evil effects will fully come to pass.
entries.plain: In its debilitation sign, or burnt by the Sun, a planet's good effects fail and its bad effects come fully true.

entries.text: if the houses be neutral signs, neither more nor less of the effects described will come to pass. All this is according to Garga.
entries.plain: In a neutral sign, the effects come true just as described, neither more nor less.

entries.text: the benefic dasa period of the Sun, a person will acquire wealth by dealing in perfumes … He will become cruel, courageous, persevering, renowned and valorous. In the malefic dasa period of the Sun, he will get into trouble through his wife, son, money, enemy, weapons, fire or the king
entries.plain: In a strong Sun period: money through trade, authorities and effort; bold, persistent and well known. In a weak one: friction over family, money, rivals or authorities, a troubled mind and strain on the chest.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).

entries.text: In the benefic dasa period of the Moon, the person will derive benefits by dealing in or by means of the mantras … he will get daughters and will acquire an increase of wisdom, wealth and renown. In the malefic dasa period of the Moon, the person will indulge in sleep and idleness, will lose his wisdom, wealth and renown and will quarrel with powerful men and with kinsmen.
entries.plain: In a strong Moon period: gains through learning, food and trade, devotion, more wisdom, money and recognition. In a weak one: lethargy, slipping money and standing, and quarrels with the powerful and with relatives.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).

entries.text: In the benefic dasa period of Mars the person will fight with his enemies, will acquire wealth through his brother, the king, lands, woollen goods and goats. … In the malefic dasa period of Mars, the person will hate his sons, friends, wife, brothers, learned men and preceptors
entries.plain: In a strong Mars period: you win against rivals and gain through siblings, authorities and land. In a weak one: friction with family and teachers, harsh speech, bad company and strain on health.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).

entries.text: In the benefic dasa period of Mercury the person will acquire wealth by doing acts of message and through friends, preceptors and Brahmins. He will attain renown among learned men … In the malefic dasa period of Mercury the person will become harsh in his speech and will suffer from grief, imprisonment, pain of mind
entries.plain: In a strong Mercury period: money through communication and friends, respect among the learned, comfort and growing wisdom. In a weak one: harsh speech, worry, restrictions and strain on health.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).

entries.text: In the benefic dasa period of Jupiter, the person will acquire wealth by acts of worship, by his learning, valor, ingenuity … In the malefic dasa period of Jupiter, the person will learn things requiring much ingenuity, will suffer from foot journey and pain in the ear and will quarrel with wicked men.
entries.plain: In a strong Jupiter period: money through learning, skill and devotion, fine possessions and friendship with the powerful. In a weak one: hard learning, tiring travel, ear trouble and quarrels with bad people.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).

entries.text: In the benefic dasa period of Venus, the person will enjoy sweet music, various pleasures, perfumes, sumptuous meals … In the malefic dasa period of Venus, the person will quarrel with crowds of people, with the king, hunters and wicked men and he will suffer much from his own friends.
entries.plain: In a strong Venus period: music, pleasures, fine food and clothes, learning, friends, success in trade and hidden wealth. In a weak one: quarrels with many people and with authorities, and trouble from friends.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).

entries.text: In the benefic dasa period of Saturn the person will get asses, camels, birds, buffaloes and old women, will rule over hamlets, villages or towns, and will thereby become renowned … In the malefic dasa period of Saturn the person will suffer from phlegmatic and windy complaints; will be jealous, angry, distracted in mind, dirty, exposed to danger, idle, suffer from grief, and be much troubled.
entries.plain: In a strong Saturn period: livestock and land, authority over a village or town, and recognition. In a weak one: aches and colds, jealousy, anger, a scattered mind, idleness and grief.
entries.note: Brihat Jataka gives a benefic and a malefic result for each dasha; which applies depends on the planet's strength (8.5-7, 8.19).
